intro: Tourism and tuna fishing drive the economy of the Seychelles.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tourism is the biggest industry. Victoria has one of the world's biggest tuna canneries. The Seychelles is one of Africa's richest countries per person.

chapters.title: Blue economy
text: The Seychelles pioneered 'blue bonds' to fund ocean protection.

keyTerms.meaning: A factory that puts food in cans.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things the Seychelles makes and sells to the world.
